id: title:danielcarletti:isolate source module imports so one broken source can t take down the rest

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion resilience: P1.F1.H2 adds logging and a fallback loading implementation, allowing warehouse ingestion to continue if a single vendor SDK bulk import fails rather than terminating the entire warehouse sync.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H2 explicitly implements fallback loading and exception capture. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement in warehouse ingestion reliability: if the bulk import fails, the system falls back to per-source import and continues, rather than failing the warehouse sync entirely.
